description: This file contains a function 'extension_check' that validates the file extension of a model file used in ImageAI, ensuring compatibility with the underlying framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow). It raises errors if the model file extension is incompatible or missing.

methods.name: extension_check
methods.description: Validates the model file extension to ensure compatibility with ImageAI's backend framework, raising errors for unsupported or missing extensions.
